pages.title: Motion that assembles.
pages.subtitle: Parts slide along the mark’s own axes and lock together. Every logo animation ends on the still logo.
pages.name: Motion

elements.text: Assemble, don’t decorate. Motion shows parts fitting together. Every logo animation ends on the exact still logo: no bounce, blur, glow or colour change.
One thing at a time. Stagger related parts by 80 ms. Move along the mark’s own axes: vertical, or the 3 : 5 isometric slope.
Loops are for waiting. Only loaders loop, and only the mark loops, never the full logo. Stop the loop as soon as the wait is over.
Still is a valid frame. With reduced motion, show the final frame. Nothing should depend on the animation to be understood.
All sixteen studies, with replay, are in motion/index.html in the kit and in brandkit’s Motion tab.

studies.name: Assemble
studies.use: Site intro, video opener, app launch
studies.description: The two blocks slide in along the isometric axis and lock together; then FIRST and FORM rise into place.

studies.name: Build
studies.description: Each block is built face by face: top, side, then the outline of the open front.

studies.name: Draw
studies.description: The line drawing of both blocks traces in, then the solid faces fill.

studies.name: Turn
studies.use: Explaining the mark; loading handing over to ready
studies.description: The second block starts on top of the first and turns 180° into place. The mark’s construction, shown.

studies.name: Block loader
studies.use: Page and app loading, 24 px and up
studies.description: The blocks part along their axis and meet again. Mark only; stops when loading ends.

studies.name: Stack
studies.description: Three isometric blocks drop onto each other, then clear for the next round.

studies.name: Module
studies.use: Panels and lists while content loads
studies.description: The design icon’s grid, with its one moving part travelling cell to cell.

studies.name: Overlap
studies.description: The consultation icon’s two circles meet in the middle and part again.

studies.name: Focus
studies.description: Viewfinder brackets close in, the crosshair sets, and the photo comes up behind it.

studies.name: Progress
studies.description: A pill track fills in three steps, lighting each stage as it passes.

studies.name: Skeleton
studies.use: Cards and lists before data arrives
studies.description: Placeholder bars with a highlight passing along the 3 : 5 diagonal.

studies.name: Cards
studies.description: White, Graphite and Black cards rise 24 px into place, one after another.

studies.name: Headline
studies.description: Each line rises out of its own mask.

studies.name: Field
studies.description: The field takes focus, the entry types in, and Send turns into a drawn check.

studies.name: Press
studies.description: A pill presses in to 96% and darkens to Graphite, then lets go.

studies.name: Wipe
studies.description: The next page sweeps in behind an edge cut at the mark’s slope.
